items.q: Then we got a bass player, after about two weeks by the name of Red Wooten

ctx.x: Jimmy Wyle, who was with me for years with the quintet. Then we got a bass player, after about two weeks by the name of Red Wooten, who had been with Tommy Dorsey and Woody Herman, and other bands, he was living in California -- and a great bass player and he joined us and I don't know, next thing I know, Lonnie Prozier calls me for the Tropicana, which was open, and so I said sat down, "I'd been up there at the Sahara, and I was unhappy and I didn't want to -- and he said, "Well, I'm having them bring the trio…
